description:
The plan finder. Ranks every eligible VHIS plan on what it covers and what it really costs, and returns three
    explained picks (lowest cost over the period, best coverage for the money, most comprehensive) with a ranked list
    behind them. Coverage is read from each plan's Benefit Schedule; cost is the published premium for every year from
    this age, and the same again with the insurer's own filed rate changes applied. Age is the only thing it needs;
    pass whatever else the person has actually said.

age.description: Age last birthday, as the premium schedules state it
age.title: Age

budget_annual.description: Most they want to pay in the first year, in the plan currency
budget_annual.title: Budget Annual

gender.description: M or F, as the schedules rate it
gender.title: Gender

max_deductible.description: 0 for no deductible; leave empty to allow deductible plans, which cost less
max_deductible.title: Max Deductible

needs.description: Must-haves they named, any of: full_cover, no_annual_limit, mental_health, cancer, outpatient_general, dental, maternity, chinese_medicine, health_check, emergency_assistance, cash_benefit, second_opinion, home_nursing, deductible_waiver
needs.title: Needs

room.description: Minimum hospital room class wanted: Ward | Semi-private | Private
room.title: Room

smoker.description: True only if the person said they smoke; a few plans rate for it
smoker.title: Smoker

territory.description: Where cover is needed: hong_kong | greater_china | asia | worldwide_ex_us | worldwide
territory.title: Territory

years.description: Period the cost is totalled over
years.title: Years

name: find_plans
title: Find plans on coverage and price
